operator: A(y) is first-Chern quantum multiplication on the returned ambient sector; columns are images of basis vectors.
point_convention: Each factor, determinant and exponent multiset refers to the point in its own record. Atomic Hodge data may use a different explicitly stated point.
exponent_convention: classes are regularized exponents modulo Z, counted separately for each eigenvalue. Repeated entries retain multiplicity. powers are representatives, not a term-by-term pairing with the sorted classes. Null means no multiset is specified; it is never an empty multiset.
provenance: Exact connection analysis of the stored localization matrices and returned gradings. Factors from negative-operator exports are converted to monic factors of A. This analysis is not a new localization run.
